Sevgi

Create SVG with Ruby

Get Started DSL Catalog

SVG in Ruby

Use familiar SVG elements and attributes directly in Ruby. Your drawing code follows the structure of the SVG it produces.

Programmable drawings

Turn data and calculations into drawings with Ruby loops and methods. Run them in an application or as executable .sevgi scripts.

Reusable components

Define drawing components with parameters and reuse them across documents. Compose them into groups, layers, or SVG symbols.

Geometry and layout

Calculate intersections and bounds, fit rulers and grids, and hatch shapes. Inspect layout values before you turn them into SVG.

SVG round trip

Convert existing SVG into Ruby source or import selected elements. Combine artwork from a visual editor with layouts built in code.

Export options

Use the same drawing as SVG in an application or file. Add optional PDF and PNG export for print and raster output.
